step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), display the [Diagnosis Menu/4WD] screen and select [DTC Freeze Data].
Using SST (TaSCAN), display the [Diagnosis Menu/4WD] screen and select [DTC].
Select [Clear] on the screen to clear the data.

atten3.ptxt: DTCs and freeze frame data are cleared at the same time.

step2.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch OFF, and using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch ON, and read the DTCs from the number of blinks of the 4WD warning light.

item.ptxt: If normal, the light repeatedly comes on for 0.25 seconds and goes off for 0.25 seconds.

If there is 1 DTC, the same code is output repeatedly at 4-second intervals; if multiple codes are output, the different codes are output at 2.5-second intervals. After one cycle is complete, the codes are output again after a 4-second interval.
If multiple code numbers are output, they are displayed in ascending numerical order.

step2.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch OFF, and using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch ON and depress the brake pedal 8 times or more within 5 seconds. (Turn the stop light switch OFF-ON 8 times or more.)
Check that the normal code is output.

item.ptxt: If the DTCs cannot be cleared, repeat the above operation.
If the malfunction persists, the DTCs may not be cleared.
